systems.owner: not stated; the project hands unserviceable weapons to SLeCAA
systems.tiers: planned project 329: mark and record all weapons owned by the military and the police and those licensed to civilians, with regional offices in Kenema and Port Loko; the plan does not say the register is digital

note: Passages only: the plan lists weak forensic capacity at the Scientific Support Unit, too few juvenile holding centres at police stations and posts, and projects to build and rehabilitate police stations; it names no system for station records and says nothing of how stations record.
